title: 先锋领航收购财富平台Altruist，布局独立顾问市场
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is a departure from Vanguard, you're known for growing organically. Why not go that method in expanding into wealth? Why does it make sense for Altruis who you've already partnered with
segments.zh: 这与Vanguard一贯的风格不同，你们以有机增长著称。为何不通过这种方式扩展财富管理？既然已与Altruis合作，为何直接收购？

segments.en: to outright buy it? You know, we've been an investor in Altruis going back more than half a dozen years. So we are a minority investor kind of in the early days when Jason and his team
segments.zh: 我们**Altruis已有六七年，早期就是少数股东，当时Jason和他的团队刚起步。

segments.en: were first getting started. And what we are impressed back then about is what we're also impressed about today. The first piece was really the mission that Jason had found in the firm around,
segments.zh: 当时让我们印象深刻的地方，今天依然如此。首先是Jason为公司设定的使命，

segments.en: which is making advice more accessible, more affordable, and better for many more Americans.
segments.zh: 即让更多美国人获得更便捷、更实惠、更优质的理财建议。

segments.en: And the second piece, which is really takes us to today, is just the tenacity with which Jason and the team have really been building their business. And from a Vanguard perspective,
segments.zh: 其次，Jason和团队在业务建设上的坚韧，让我们走到了今天。从Vanguard的角度看，

segments.en: we want to do for financial advice, what we've done for the past 50 years, for investments, which is really make it much more accessible to many more people. And part of this alignment
segments.zh: 我们希望像过去50年改变**那样，改变理财建议，让更多人能够获得。这种使命的契合，

segments.en: around the mission, right, when Jason was talking about the mission of Altruis to me and we were comparing notes. A lot of what he was trying to do rhymed with what we were trying to do. And I think
segments.zh: 当Jason向我介绍Altruis的使命时，我们对比了想法，他的许多努力与我们的方向不谋而合。

segments.en: in that, it really led to this moment. Well, I'm assuming part of the mission has been this fast gross growth and nimbleness that Altruis has, Jason. I mean, you're in California. You're
segments.zh: 正是这一点促成了现在的决定。我猜Altruis的使命之一就是快速成长和灵活应变，Jason。你在加州，

segments.en: away from the hub of financial services here in New York. Why not stay independent? Why partner
segments.zh: 远离纽约的金融服务中心。为何不保持独立？为何选择合作？
